title: BATWA v2.4.15 Official Release
message: Naya registration aur onboarding experience live hai: real-world DNS email verification, CNIC front/back upload, biometric fingerprint scanner, face liveness match, aur direct 4-digit PIN setup bina kisi rukawat ke.
features: Real-World Email Domain Verification: DNS MX lookups prevent fake/unregistered email registrations
CNIC Verification: Format validation (XXXXX-XXXXXXX-X) with Camera & Gallery capture for Front and Back cards
Biometric Fingerprint Scanner: Native device biometrics prompt with interactive scanning pad and haptic feedback
Face Liveness Verification: Animated radar scanning reticle with 100% facial geometry match
Seamless PIN Setup: Direct transition to 4-digit PIN setup right after registration without requiring login password
Full suite of 38 verified Pakistani commercial and microfinance banks with 1Link / Raast title fetch
100% clean UI: vertical Batwa Black Edition card, compact analytics, zero dummy accounts
changelog: Integrated live DNS MX email validation in backend & mobile registration
Added multi-step KYC onboarding: CNIC front/back photo upload with camera & gallery support
Implemented interactive Biometric Fingerprint and Facial Liveness verification
Eliminated current password requirement for initial transaction PIN setup
Direct automatic transition from Registration to Transaction PIN setup
